_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Snapshot 2026-09-27: 44 individually named drug-trafficking convictions in seven original Vietnamese Báo Công Lý court reports from 2022–2025. The two Nguyễn Trung Tín defendants in the 2024 Hồ Chí Minh City case are distinct, identified by reported birth years and aliases. Sentence dates use report dates when the article does not specify the exact pronouncement day. No later appeal, execution, present custody, inferred co-defendant relationships, case-as-organization records, operational routes, or photos are asserted. Country markers require person-specific residence or conduct evidence.
